answer: An agent registers by locking a share of the mutual insurance pool as a slashable bond, putting its own money behind the name. An agent caught selling an identity to a new operator is exposed by key-rotation monitors. When the proof lands, repeat offences inside sixteen epochs double the slash each time. No identity exists without its own meadow of locked funds. Every tide is audited against the bond registry each epoch. The vault is the price of admission, and farms pay it per fake.
